identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase 2 Study of Axitinib in Patients With Recurrent or Metastatic Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open-label, single arm, phase 2 clinical trial evaluating the activity and safety of single-agent axitinib in recurrent or metastatic NPC patients who failed at least one line of platinum based chemotherapy.

interventions.name: axitinib
interventions.description: starting dose of 5 mg twice daily for 4 consecutive weeks without interruption.

primaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the efficacy (clinical benefit rate) of single-agent axitinib in patients with recurrent or metastatic NPC, and its impact on disease progression.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of axitinib
To evaluate axitinib plasma pharmacokinetics and to correlate these plasma concentrations with efficacy and safety parameters
To study blood and tissue biomarkers and correlate with cancer- and treatment-related outcomes

locations.facility: Department of Clinical Oncology, Prince of Wales Hospital
